text: I think you'll enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe, which combines some of your favorite flavors and ingredients. The creamy sauce and parmesan cheese will likely appeal to your taste buds, and the use of arborio rice makes it a comforting, midwestern-style dish. The cooking time is also relatively quick, which fits with your typical time budget. Additionally, the recipe doesn't feature any ingredients you tend to rate lower, such as seasoning salt or lemon juice. Give it a try and see what you think!
